summary: Scoped approval: audit-gated snapshot of pseudonymized request traces for replay investigation (enterprise customer)
description:
Issue summary:
Requesting time-limited, strictly-scoped access to a small snapshot of request metadata and pseudonymized payloads to perform a deterministic replay for an enterprise customer (AcmeHealth). The replay is needed to reproduce a sequence of model completions that diverge from expected behavior in production.

Impact:
- Customer is reporting incorrect or malformed SOAP-like responses from the model for a paid integration.
- Investigation cannot progress without a minimal set of request traces that include request IDs, pinned model version, tokenized length, and anonymized input text.

Data requested (minimal scope):
1) 100 request trace records from 2026-03-09 00:00 to 2026-03-11 23:59 UTC selected by request_id prefix filter supplied by customer.
2) For each record: request_id, model_version, route, timestamp, sequence_length, pseudonymized_input (named-entity masked), and response hash.
3) Associated gateway TLS metadata (only headers necessary to correlate routing) for the same request_ids.

Justification:
- Deterministic replay is required to root-cause a potential model-serving regression affecting business-critical customer workflows.
- Customer has open SSO-backed support session and legal NDA in place; they have consented to diagnostic processing as part of their enterprise contract.

Proposed controls and safeguards:
- Timeboxed access: artifacts provisioned for 72 hours and then automatically revoked and deleted.
- Dual-control: two approvers required (SRE lead + Compliance owner) before any artifact is exported.
- KMS-wrapped bundle: artifacts encrypted with customer-specific KMS key for transit and at-rest access; decryption only allowed on approved host(s).
- Pseudonymization: free-text inputs will be masked to remove PHI/PII where any detected token is replaced with stable token IDs.
- Audit trail: all access logged to the Privileged Access Audit stream and recorded in Confluence runbook.

Steps to reproduce (requested by investigator):
1) Post-provisioning, investigator will run deterministic replay in sandbox environment using the pseudonymized traces.
2) If reproduces, investigator will escalate to model-eng with replay artifacts and high-level diff; raw inputs will not be shared externally.

Attachments / links:
- Support thread: slack:/channels/#support-acmehealth (link available internally)
- Customer ticket: SUP-20187 (customer-facing)

Requested approvals:
- SRE lead (operational risk)
- Compliance/Privacy owner (legal & privacy risk)

Time sensitivity: High — customer SLA breach risk if not investigated within 48 hours.
